architecture_features: Centralized SQLite / PostgreSQL compatible state persistence with atomic ACID transactions.
Zero calendar date coupling: seasons utilize relative duration windows and epoch ticks.
Cross-game contracts reward unified progression across distinct genres (Puzzle, Sports, Strategy, Stealth).
